title: Abbas Mere Bhai Zainab ki sada thi
body:
ABBAS MERE BHAI ZAINAB KI SADA THI
Bhaqi Koi Ghar Me Nahi Shabbir Hai Tanha
Maqtal Ki Taraf Jate Hai Ab Ibne Ali Bhi
Abid Se Litapt Ne Lagi Ghabra ke Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaimo Me Sitamgaron Ne Jab Aag Lagai
Bimar Ko Zanjeer Pinata Hai Sitamgar
Had Hogai Ab Zulm Ki Aur Joro Jafa Bhi
Sukhe Gale Pe Rakdiya Zalim Ne Jo Qanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jungle Me Luthi Jati Hai Zehra Ki Kamai
Abbas-e-Ali Bali Sakina Ki Qabr Lo
Karti Hai Tumhe Yad Wo Shabbir Ki Pyaari
Sine Pe Sakina Ko Sulati Haumai Dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
Thi Mujh Ko Waisyat Yeh Hussain Ibne Ali
Sar Nange Huye Sham Be Bazaar Me Dekho
Thathir Ki Waris Wo Mohammed Ki Nawasi
Zainab Ka Nahi Koi Musibat ke Sahara
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanha Hai Binte Hyder-e-Karrar Ki Beti
Abbas Se Khati Thi Fida Zainab-e-Dilgeer
Ab Qaid Sitam Se Meri Hogi Bhi Rehai
